headlines.title: בתום שעות של חיפושים: נעצר החשוד החמוש שנמלט ממטע זיתים בכפר קרע
headlines.snippet: After hours of searching, an armed suspect who fled from an olive grove in Kafr Qara was arrested. The suspect was located and apprehended with the assistance of the Shin Bet after extensive searches involving police, border police, and helicopters. An M-16 rifle was found concealed in the ground near the scene. The suspect has been transferred for interrogation, and the background of the incident is still being investigated. Earlier reports indicated the suspect was wearing khaki-colored military uniforms and fled after civilians attempted to question him.

headlines.snippet: President Trump was asked if he trusts Prime Minister Netanyahu and replied, "In politics, I don't trust anyone." The American president stated in an interview with NewsMax that Israeli officials wanted him to intervene in the election. Trump emphasized that he would not use nuclear weapons against Iran but added that the situation in the Temple Mount is being monitored, stating, "We will strike it and destroy it quickly." He also said about Netanyahu, "We had good relations and successes."
